note: Facts extracted below; prose summaries are written in our own words, not copied verbatim from the source. Page is very large (36000+ chars) — Fairs/Food/How-to-Reach sections after the place listings not fully captured, but all 'Places to Visit' and 'Excursions from Ludhiana' entries are captured.
about: Punjab's largest, most populous city, 'Manchester of India' for hosiery/woollen manufacturing. Founded 1480 as Lodhi-ana. Birthplace/home of freedom fighters Kartar Singh Sarabha, Sukhdev Thapar, and Lala Lajpat Rai.

places.name: Clock Tower (Ghanta Ghar)
places.timings: Tourist info centre 9am-5pm (closed Mon); tower visible always
places.location: Chaura Bazar, near Ludhiana Railway Station
places.facts: Built as Victoria Memorial Clock Tower, inaugurated 19 October 1906. Renamed Bhagwan Mahavir Clock Tower by Giani Zail Singh at the Jain community's request, still known as Ghanta Ghar.

places.name: Lodhi Fort
places.location: Domoria Bridge area, near the Sutlej River
places.facts: Oldest surviving structure in Ludhiana (~500 years), built by Sikandar Lodhi's lieutenants; held by Maharaja Ranjit Singh; 5.6 acres; state-protected monument.

places.name: Maharaja Ranjit Singh War Museum
places.entryFee: Children up to 10: Rs 10; Adults: Rs 40
places.facts: Instituted 1999; galleries on History, War Heroes, Uniforms, Air Force/Navy, Kargil; outdoor tanks, a Sukhoi fighter, INS Vikrant model.

places.name: Ancestral House of Shaheed Sukhdev Thapar
places.facts: Birthplace of Sukhdev Thapar, hanged with Bhagat Singh and Rajguru on 23 March 1931; state-protected monument.

places.name: Gurdwara Shri Dukhniwaran Sahib
places.facts: Guru Nanak Dev Ji is said to have cured a leper king here; ~50,000 devotees daily, most-visited religious site in the city.

places.name: Gurdwara Shri Gau Ghat Sahib, Patshahi Pehli
places.facts: Guru Nanak Dev Ji rested here in 1515 on the former Sutlej bank; associated with the Nawab of Lodhi.

places.name: Nehru Rose Garden
places.facts: 30 acres, 17,000+ plants, 1,600 rose varieties, illuminated musical fountain, annual Rose Festival.

places.name: Rakh Bagh
places.facts: Landscaped garden with mini train joyride; Oval Ground popular with morning walkers.

places.name: Rural Museum (Punjab Agricultural University Museum)
places.facts: Built like traditional rural Punjabi houses; agricultural implements, crafts, household objects; only university museum of its kind in India.

places.name: Mughal Sarai, Doraha
places.facts: ~168 sq m enclosure caravanserai, battlement walls, octagonal bastions, painted rooms; 20-30 rooms per side.

places.name: Sarai Lashkari Khan
places.location: Near Doraha, ~30km from Ludhiana on GT Road
places.facts: 17th-century Aurangzeb-era caravanserai; popularly called 'RDB Fort' after Aamir Khan filmed Rang De Basanti here; two intact gateways.

places.name: Maharaja Ranjit Singh Fort, Phillaur
places.location: Phillaur, ~14km from Ludhiana on GT Road
places.facts: Built early 19th century under Maharaja Ranjit Singh; Sikh-Mughal blended architecture; now houses a Dargah, museum, and Punjab Police training facility.

places.name: Ancestral House of Shaheed Kartar Singh Sarabha
places.facts: Birthplace (24 May 1896) of the Ghadar Party revolutionary hanged at 19 in 1915; personal hero of Bhagat Singh; state-protected monument.

places.name: Ancestral House of Lala Lajpat Rai
places.facts: Home of Punjab Kesari, martyred 1928; now a museum with a life-size statue; state-protected monument.

places.name: Gurdwara Charan Kanwal Sahib, Machhiwara
places.location: Charan Kamal Road, Machhiwara, ~35km from Ludhiana
places.facts: Guru Gobind Singh Ji rested here during his guerrilla campaign after evacuating Anandpur Sahib.

places.name: Anglo-Sikh War Memorial, Aliwal
places.facts: Commemorates the 1845 First Anglo-Sikh War battle at Aliwal.

places.name: Maharaja Duleep Singh Memorial, Raikot
places.facts: Housed in Bassian Kothi, temporary 1850 lodge of the last Maharaja of Punjab before exile; also held Kuka Movement prisoners.

places.name: Kos Minar (Mile Pillars)
places.location: Along the Grand Trunk Road, Ludhiana district
places.facts: 16th-century Sher Shah Suri-era distance markers, ~30ft round pillars.

places.name: Mani Laxmi Dham
places.location: Near village Bija/Bhourla, NH Delhi-Ludhiana, near Doraha
places.facts: Jain pilgrimage complex, ~Rs 300 crore construction cost, holds a Guinness World Record.

places.name: Ancient Site of Sunet
places.facts: ASI-protected archaeological site.

places.name: Christ Church, Fountain Chowk
places.timings: Check locally, closed Sundays for visits
places.facts: Built by the British in the 1830s.

places.name: Jama Masjid
places.facts: Built 1891 by Maulana Shah Mohammad Ludhianavi.

places.name: Qila Payal and Ancient Baoli, Payal
places.facts: Built 1771 by Maharaja Amar Singh of Patiala with Mughal cooperation; state-protected monument.

places.name: Tombs at Behlolpur
places.facts: 4 Mughal-era red-sandstone tombs including Alawal Khan, Hussain Khan, Nawab Bahadur Khan.

howToReach.note: Not fully captured in this scrape session; Ludhiana has its own domestic airport and is a major railway junction on the Delhi-Amritsar line.
